references.text: Describes the tribute to the Lord from the spoils of war—one out of every five hundred was to be given as a gift to the Lord through the priest Eleazar.
Summarizes the total number of people taken captive, which this verse is part of distributing.
The principle of giving a tenth or tithe to the Lord from what one receives, which also applies to spoils of war.
Concerns the valuation of persons dedicated to the Lord, relevant to the concept of people belonging to the Lord.
The law regarding spoils of war, including women, who could be taken as plunder from enemy cities.
